card.summary: BGPTunnel.com offers free IPv4 and IPv6 Transit via GRE Tunnels in various locations for non-commercial and personal networks via AS209533.

free_tier.stated: BGPTunnel.com offers free IPv4 and IPv6 Transit via GRE Tunnels in various locations for non-commercial and personal networks via AS209533.

egress.terms: no traffic allowance is published on the landing page; ingress: tcp+udp

record.interface_detail: BGP over GRE tunnels, self-service for ASN holders
record.tooling: a GRE interface, BGP daemon and an announced prefix on the client side
record.chaining: only after obtaining an ASN and PI space, which is a paid prerequisite; not a path to free ingress on its own.
record.binding_note: Nothing in the vocabulary is reached, because the offer is not a prefix handed to a client: it is transit for a network that already holds an ASN and its own address space. That gate is identity, recorded in identity_cost, and it is passed before any volume is transferred.

identity_cost.detail: third-party list: 'Only BGP, bring your own subnet/asn.' The vendor page confirms 'Transit via GRE Tunnels ... for non-commercial and personal networks' but names no account fields.

record.reliability_note: no SLA or allowance published on the landing page.
record.confidence_note: the landing page read establishes only a GRE-based BGP transit offer; the ASN requirement and the /126 come from the tunnelbroker.services list. A vendor page naming the prerequisites would raise it.

evidence.proved: 'BGPTunnel.com offers free IPv4 and IPv6 Transit via GRE Tunnels in various locations for non-commercial and personal networks via AS209533.'
'Only BGP, bring your own subnet/asn.' with a /126 prefix and AS209533
route48.org now resolves here, which is how the successor was found

record.notes: This is the successor to tunnelbroker.li and to route48.org. It is a transit product, not a tunnel broker: an ASN and PI space would be needed first, which NetAssist sells for EUR 300/year. That cost is what makes it unusable rather than the service.

extras.wg_detail: no WireGuard is described on the landing page; the third-party list credits it with WireGuard but the vendor page names GRE tunnels and BGP transit only
extras.volume_stated: no traffic allowance is published on the landing page
extras.transit_note: AS209533 announces and carries the customer prefix.
